data.title: Bitcoin Is Down 44% and Its Miners Are Up 90%. The AI Pivot Explains Everything.
data.description: Bitcoin miners were supposed to track bitcoin, but the biggest names in the space have quietly rewired their business models around something else entirely, and the performance gap between the coin and its miners has never been wider.
